title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 2
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Grieg and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all talk about Cornucopias' latest developments including: The new roadmap, community animations, NFT tech and OG NFT, Mobile Mini game update, and a first look leak!.. timber 🌳🪵🏡

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the causal, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

0:00 - Intro
0:30 - Beverage Choices
2:00 - Organization Improvements
3:26 - Roadmap Updates
4:15 - Community Artwork
9:20 - New NFT Marketplace
15:00 - Derp Shout-Out
18:10 - Land Sale
19:16 - $COPI Token Bridge to Cardano
21:05 - Minswap Yield Farming
21:50 - Mobile Game Update
25:40 - Bubblejett + GTi Javelin Utility
28:15 - Land Leak
30:25 - Wrap-Up

Be sure to like and subscribe to our channel for more developments from the Cornucopias metaverse project! Also, check out our social channels below:

https://linktr.ee/Cornucopias.Game
